basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated separately through e-mail

age_limit.details: The age limit for the Consultant position is below 40 years as of the cut-off date. Cut-off date for determining the age/experience/educational qualification shall be 29.10.2026.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | consultant: 03 years Diploma in Electrical Engineering with at least 60% of marks or its equivalent CGPA grading with 06-year experience after diploma.ORB.Tech./B.E. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering with at least 60% of marks or its equivalent CGPA grading with 03 years experience after degree. Applicants with integrated M.Tech./M.E. degree will also be eligible.

salary_details.consultant: Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- per month (consolidated remuneration)
salary_details.details: The remuneration will be commensurate with the candidates' domain knowledge, skills and experience. The remuneration shall not be more than twenty percent higher than the remunerations received in any of the previous services/engagements. The remuneration may be reviewed after completion of one year on annual basis, with an annual remuneration increment ranging between 03% to 10%, subject to performance assessment by the Reporting and Reviewing Officer.

selection_process: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications by a Committee followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.
Applications received within the due date will be shortlisted by a Committee
and only the shortlisted candidates will be considered for the interview. The date of the interview will be intimated separately through e-mail to shortlisted candidates only.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website of IIT Delhi at www.iitd.ac.in and go to Jobs@IITDelhi under the heading Non-Academic.
Fill out the application form completely with detailed information regarding educational percentage/division and work experience.
Affix a recent passport size photograph duly filled by yourself on the application form.
Scan the filled application form along with self-attested copies of documents supporting educational qualification and experience in PDF format at a resolution of 300 dpi or higher.
Email the complete set of documents to [email protected] on or before 29.10.2026.
Ensure no hard copy is submitted through post or courier.
important_instructions: This is purely a temporary engagement, and appearance in the interview and selection thereafter does not entitle any claim whatsoever for permanency on the regular establishment of IIT Delhi. Immediate joinees will be preferred. Incomplete application forms will be summarily rejected. Candidates must produce original certificates and documents in support of educational qualification and work experience at the time of the interview or joining, if selected. If any information is found false or incorrect at any stage, the candidature and appointment are liable to be cancelled. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, postpone or cancel the recruitment altogether without assigning any reason thereof. There is no need to submit hard copy through Post/Courier.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Consultant Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications by a Committee followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates. Applications received within the due date will be shortlisted by a Committee, and only the shortlisted candidates will be considered for the interview. The date of the interview will be intimated separately through e-mail to shortlisted candidates only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Consultant
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of IIT Delhi at www.iitd.ac.in and go to Jobs@IITDelhi under the heading Non-Academic. Download the prescribed specimen "Application Form". Fill out the application form completely with detailed information regarding educational percentage/division and work experience. Affix a recent passport size photograph duly filled by yourself on the application form. Scan the filled application form along with self-attested copies of documents supporting educational qualification and experience in PDF format at a resolution of 300 dpi or higher. Email the complete set of documents to [email protected] on or before 29.10.2026 . Ensure no hard copy is submitted through post or courier.
